Tech (Electrical & Electronics Engineering) – Biju Patnaik University of Technology | 2008 -2012 | 6.8 / 10 UC Davis & Coursera – Research Reports & Delivering Insights LearnTube AI – Project Management & Data Analytics Growth School – Management Consulting WORK EXPERIENCE Freelancer (Project Management, Digital Transformation, Change Management) Hyderabad | Jan 2025 - Present Delivered independent consulting assignments across digital transformation, business transformation, organization change management, project management, market intelligence, business analysis, and strategic advisory Worked directly with clients to understand transformation objectives, business challenges, stakeholder requirements, and expected outcomes Developed actionable plans for managing resistance, adoption barriers, competing priorities, communication gaps, and organizational readiness Designed practical change strategies and transformation roadmaps aligned with client objectives, timelines, organizational readiness, and available resources Delivered projects independently from initial assessment through planning, execution, stakeholder management, reporting, and closure Project Manager – Digital Transformation, Change Management & PMO Evalueserve Pvt. Ltd. | Gurgaon | Dec 2023 – Jan 2025 Managed large-scale transformation and transition projects across shared services and GCC environments. Conducted change impact assessments, stakeholder workshops, and design sessions to identify process inefficiencies and improvement opportunities Owned end-to-end communication planning and governance for transformation and client-facing programmes, establishing communication calendars, stakeholder matrices, communication cadences, escalation mechanisms and governance routines Led change management work streams and delivery methodologies using Agile and Scrum methodology across digital transformation, technology implementation, process redesign, operating model transformation, and organizational change initiatives. Performed organizational readiness assessments to identify capability gaps, stakeholder concerns, adoption risks, and implementation barriers Coordinated cross-functional teams, system integrators, business users, and technical consultants to ensure successful project execution. Prepared and presented Steering Committee/leadership communications, including executive status updates, program dashboards, milestone summaries, RAID updates, decision papers, briefing packs, and management presentations Translated complex project and transformation information into clear, concise, and business-oriented communications, highlighting what was changing, why it mattered, expected business impact, required stakeholder actions, and key timelines Supported business readiness and change management activities by developing stakeholder communications around process changes, technology changes, new ways of working, implementation milestones, training requirements, and adoption activities Designed As-Is and To-Be process maps, enabling streamlined workflows and improved operational scalability. Led cross-functional teams and coordinated deliverables across geographically distributed stakeholders, ensuring communication dependencies were incorporated into project plans, milestones, and governance forums Senior Analyst – Change Management, Program Strategy & Consulting Accenture Strategy & Consulting | Bengaluru | Oct 2021 – Nov 2023 Supported digital transformation and technology consulting programmes, coordinating communication across business stakeholders, technology teams, research teams, project managers, and senior leadership Developed executive-ready program updates, stakeholder presentations, briefing documents and management dashboards covering project progress, key milestones, risks, dependencies, business implications and recommended actions Identified budget risks, developed corrective actions, supported business case development & investment prioritization, and tracked financial ROI benefits throughout the transformation lifecycle. Coordinated with Finance and Procurement to ensure program financial reporting Coordinated cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging, timely information flow, and alignment of deliverables across multiple transformation workstreams Converted complex technology and digital transformation findings into clear business narratives and stakeholder communications, enabling senior decision-makers to understand program progress and implications Worked with business and technology stakeholders to identify communication gaps, stakeholder concerns, dependencies and delivery risks, escalating critical items through established governance channels Supported Agile delivery practices including Scrum ceremonies, sprint updates, status reporting and stakeholder reviews, ensuring communication remained aligned with delivery progress Analyzed adoption trends and stakeholder feedback to identify gaps and recommend corrective actions. Maintained change RAID logs, risk registers, issue trackers, dependency trackers, decision logs, action plans, and integrated change risks & dependencies into program governance Analyst – Digital Transformation & Change Management Global Data Research Center | Hyderabad | Jan 2018 – Oct 2021 Managed communication across 20+ consulting engagements, working with clients, internal research teams, subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders to maintain alignment on project objectives, timelines, deliverables and business outcomes Developed client-facing presentations, executive briefing packs, market intelligence reports, newsletters and strategic updates, translating complex research and analytical findings into actionable business messaging Presented project findings and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders, ensuring clear articulation of business impact, market opportunities, risks, priorities and recommended actions Designed and implemented KPI frameworks, performance scorecards, dashboards, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor business performance and operational effectiveness. Conducted performance trend analysis and variance impact assessments to identify business risks Supported client engagement through structured project updates, review meetings, milestone communications and presentation materials, strengthening transparency throughout the engagement lifecycle Partnered cross-functionally to convert digital transformation insights into measurable business actions and strategic priorities. Strengthened compliance adherence across projects by integrating regulatory requirements, quality checks, and governance reviews into delivery processes Business Analyst – Change Management and PMO Algo Energytech Ventures Pvt. Ltd. (Now Xempla) | Kolkata | Jul 2017 – Jan 2018 Performed advanced data analytics and business intelligence analysis on large-scale operational, consumption, and performance datasets to identify cost optimization opportunities, process inefficiencies, and resource utilization improvements, driving measurable business impact Designed and implemented analytical frameworks, KPI dashboards, and executive reporting solutions to support product strategy, financial decision-making, performance monitoring, and data-driven business transformation initiatives Delivered analytics-led transformation initiatives by partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex data insights into actionable recommendations, improving operational efficiency, customer value, and overall business outcomes Assistant Manager – Consulting & PMO E-Cube Energy Trading Pvt. Ltd. | Kolkata | Jun 2015 – Jun 2017 Led strategy consulting and data-driven business transformation initiatives by analysing operational performance, market research, and business metrics to identify optimization opportunities, improve operational efficiency, and drive sustainable performance improvements Developed and implemented advanced analytics models, BI dashboards, and performance reporting frameworks to identify productivity gaps, operational inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, enabling data-driven decision-making and measurable process enhancements Delivered actionable business insights and strategic recommendations by combining market intelligence, operational analytics, and KPI analysis to support revenue growth, process optimization, and operational excellence initiatives for industrial sector clients



SECTOR EXPERTISE

BFSI: Financial Transformation, Process Re-engineering, Portfolio Management, M&A analysis, Risk Management

FMCG: Consumer Insights, Category Management, Pricing Strategy, Channel GTM, Growth Strategy, Business Analytics

TMT / ITES: Digital transformation, Project Management, RTM Strategy, Process Management, PMO, Transition Management
